export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec118/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && cat >> eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl <<'JSONL'
{"round": 2, "original_goal": "仕様書・アーキテクチャをplugins/system-spec-harness/の正規フローで構築し、出典・確定状態・上位目的traceを保ったままdev-graphのspecification/architectureノードへ取り込んだ状態になっている", "original_goal_hash": "30a1de05fc91233a51fb054852bc389252948f969d89393207f5ef5c382ce454", "current_goal_snapshot": "build-evaluation-context exit0のskill_argsでC05を起動。3監査(C07/C06/C08)はresolved PASSだが総合verdict=FAIL (decision_guidance: D4比較不成立)。IN1 3ゲートexit0。C02未起動", "delta_from_original": "evaluator PASSが得られずC02登録・lineage gate・R3が未達", "merged_directive_for_next": "D4をR5-decision-guideで案別比較し直し、利用者の採否を中立な問で取り直してからC05を再評価する。新しい利用者入力が必要なため本runでは実行せずFAILで停止", "drift_signal": "none"}
JSONL
DEV_GRAPH_ROOT='/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec118/fx' && python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
echo "hash_check_exit=$?"
